analyzed_vuln.description: _cmsMLUgetWide trusts mlu->UsedEntries and iterates entries without validating that UsedEntries <= AllocatedEntries (or that each entry’s StrW/Len stays within MemPool). A malformed cmsMLU (created from fuzzed profile tag data) can therefore make the loop read past the allocated Entries array, causing the heap-buffer-overflow seen at cmsnamed.c:346 during language/country comparison. The crash manifests via cmsMLUgetASCII in CRD-info tag serialization, but the root cause is missing structural bounds validation in _cmsMLUgetWide.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In cms_profile_fuzzer, attacker-controlled ICC bytes are opened as a profile, tags are parsed, then profile is saved (cmsSaveProfileToFile). During save, Type_CrdInfo_Write -> WriteCountAndString calls cmsMLUgetASCII on a cmsMLU originating from parsed tag content. If that cmsMLU has inconsistent internal counters (notably UsedEntries larger than actual allocated entry storage), _cmsMLUgetWide iterates out of bounds and performs a 2-byte read beyond heap allocation, triggering ASan.
